Writes two fields directly (a float at this+7356 = 293.16f / 1133679739 and a byte flag at this+7352 = 1), then runs a 4-iteration loop that writes a repeating pattern: an offset float (293.16f), several byte flags (1, 0), and a triple of equal floats (359.86f / 1135865364) into array fields at this+7384, this+7380 and this+7404 respectively, advancing the three cursors each iteration. operations.description: Set the dword at this+7356 (0x1CBC) to literal 1133679739 (float 293.16).
Set the byte at this+7352 (0x1CB8) to literal 1.
Seed three cursors: result = this+7380 (0x1CD4), v3 = this+7384 (0x1CD8), v2 = this+7404 (0x1CEC).
do-while loop that runs 4 iterations, ending when the result cursor has advanced 4 bytes past this+7380.
Each iteration writes the literal 1133679739 (float 293.16) to a dword 5 dwords before the v3 cursor and the literal 1 to a byte 20 bytes before the result cursor.
Each iteration writes 0 to the dword at the v3 cursor, 1 to the byte at the result cursor, and 1 to the byte 20 bytes ahead of the result cursor.
Each iteration writes the literal 1135865364 (float 359.86) to three consecutive dwords starting at the v2 cursor.
Advance the cursors each iteration: v3 += 1 dword, v2 += 3 dwords, result += 1 byte.
Return the result cursor after the loop (points past the last initialized byte).
